source_title: Railway bridge near Andhra’s Ichchapuram inundated
source_excerpt: VISAKHAPATNAM Train operations in the Visakhapatnam Division were severely hit on Thursday (October 29, 2026) morning following heavy water inundation at Bridge No. 1052 (Up) between the Ichchapuram and Jhadupudi sections, triggered by an overflowing local rivulet. Railway authorities were forced to cancel, short-terminate and divert several passenger and express services after water levels crossed the danger mark. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/rivers-in-spate-in-north-andhra-after-cyclone-arnab-flood-water-enters-ichchapuram/article71638931.ece According to South Coast Railway officials, multiple local and express operations scheduled for October 29 have been cancelled or altered. Train No. 58531 Brahmapur-Visakhapatnam Passenger, Train No. 18525 Brahmapur-Visakhapatnam Express and Train No. 58532 Visakhapatnam-Brahmapur Passenger have been cancelled. IMPORTANT TRAIN UPDATE.... In view of heavy rainfall followed by Cyclone Arnab, severe waterlogging has occurred in the Ichhapuram–Jhadupudi section of Visakhapatnam Division under South Coast Railway. Passenger safety remains our top priority. As a precautionary measure, several trains are being cancelled, diverted, short-terminated, short-originated and controlled within the East Coast Railway jurisdiction. Passengers are requested to bear with the situation and advised to stay tuned to the official platforms of East Coast Railway for the latest updates on train operations and travel advisories. #TravelAdvisory #ECoRupdate #Passengerinformation #Passengersafety #CycloneArnab @RailMinIndia— East Coast Railway (@EastCoastRail) October 29, 2026 To help stranded passengers, South Coast Railway has arranged to run a special train service between Visakhapatnam and Palasa. Helpline desks have been set up at Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam and other major stations to give travellers the latest updates.
